Aipas M1 Pro Xterrain ST eBike Overview
The Aipas M1 Pro Xterrain ST is a step-through model in the Aipas off-road electric bikes lineup. It is built for riders who want easier mounting, strong motor support, and stable control on steep hills, forest paths, rough roads, and mixed terrain. Its 26×4.0 fat tires also connect the M1 Pro to the Aipas fat tire ebikes collection by adding traction, balance, and comfort on gravel, sand, snow, and uneven surfaces.

Off-Road Role: This 1800W motor and 110Nm torque are core reasons the M1 Pro belongs in the Aipas off-road electric bikes lineup, supporting steep hills, forest paths, and rough terrain.

Stability: Provides solid handling and long-lasting durability in diverse riding conditions.

Frame Role: The step-through frame positions the M1 Pro as the easier-access option within the Aipas off-road electric bikes lineup.

Charging Options: Convenient built-in waterproof design and removable battery charging.For extended range options, check the M1 Pro/M2 Pro 48V 17.5AH Battery.

Benefit: Smoothly absorbs bumps and shocks for a comfortable off-road or city ride.Enhance comfort further with the Suspension Seatpost for long-distance rides.

Performance: Provides precise, reliable, and consistent stopping power in all weather conditions.

6. Fat Tire Stability

Fat Tire Role: The 26×4.0 tire setup also connects the M1 Pro to the Aipas fat tire ebikes collection.
Surface Fit: Adds grip, balance, and comfort on gravel, sand, snow, rough roads, and mixed surfaces.

7. Smart LCD Display

Display: Shows speed, mileage, battery level, and pedal assist in real time

Extras: Built-in USB port to charge your devices while using a Phone Mount for easy navigation.

Transmission: Shimano 7-speed system for an adaptable and efficient riding experience.

9. Easy Assembly

Setup: 90% pre-assembled with front wheel installed, allowing quick setup even for new riders.

Summary
The Aipas M1 Pro Xterrain ST is best understood as the step-through option within the Aipas off-road electric bikes lineup. Its 1800W motor, 110Nm torque, full suspension, and dual disc brakes define its off-road role, helping riders handle steep hills, forest paths, rough roads, and mixed terrain with more control.
Its 26×4.0 fat tires also give the M1 Pro a clear connection to the Aipas fat tire ebikes collection, adding traction, balance, and comfort on gravel, sand, snow, and uneven surfaces. For shoppers comparing off-road models, the M1 Pro is the easier-access choice, while other Aipas off-road ebikes may offer different frame styles, ride positions, or terrain-focused setups.
Pair it with the Lighted Cycling Helmet and Cube Electric Air Pump for a complete, safe, and ready-for-anything riding experience.
